subject: Procurement readiness & pricing/packaging alignment — Redwood
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme-analytics.com>, Tim O'Neill <tim.oneill@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + procurement questions (post-demo)

Hi Lisa / Tim —

Great to meet you both earlier — appreciate the time walking through your inference use case and the throughput/latency goals. Per our call, I wanted to capture the key items and a few procurement questions so we can move to a commercial proposal your procurement team can process.

Call recap (high level):
- Workload: interactive chat and scheduled batch embeddings for search index refreshes.
- Volume profile: initial pilot ~1M tokens/mo, expected growth to ~10M over 12 months.
- Latency target: 200-300ms p95 for chat; embeddings batch within scheduled windows.
- Security: SOC 2 scope required; potential Private deployment later.

Procurement / commercial questions:
1) Paper process: Do you require an MSA + SOW, or will a standard PO be sufficient to start?
2) PO vs card: Does your finance team prefer issuing a PO (net-30/60) or charging a corporate card for an initial pilot?
3) Marketplace: Any preference for purchasing via cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) vs direct Redwood order?
4) Commit vs on-demand: Is procurement open to a committed monthly/annual reserve for Dedicated capacity, or do you need strictly on-demand pricing for now?

Attachments: I can share a draft SOW and pricing worksheet to make approvals easier — looping Marissa (pricing/procurement lead) and Rachel (SE) to help with details.

Next steps suggested:
- You confirm PO vs card and any paper/contracting requirements.
- If PO, please share your PO template and billing details (I see Tim is on procurement loop).
- Marissa / Rachel will propose 2 commercial paths (pilot on Hosted on-demand with monthly card vs 12-month commit for Dedicated) and send a SOW draft.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the SOW + pricing options once I have your PO template / preference.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOW_Draft.pdf (will attach on follow-up)

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tim O'Neill <tim.oneill@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + procurement questions (post-demo)

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from procurement to help you shape the paperwork:

- Paper: We typically need an MSA for multi-year engagements, but for pilots under $50k we can accept a PO referencing our standard terms.
- PO vs card: Preferred route is PO (net-30). We can do card for very small one-off charges, but for pilot and potential scale we want a PO.
- Marketplace: Marketplace purchases are preferred by our cloud team because of consolidated billing, but procurement can handle direct vendor POs if there is a compelling reason.
- Commit vs on-demand: For the pilot we likely need on-demand-ish flexibility, but if we see predictable usage by month 3 we are open to discussing a 12-month commit for cost savings.

Attaching our PO template and a brief vendor questionnaire that finance requires (vendor_tax_id redacted). Please confirm Redwood's billing address and whether you can accept net-30.

Lisa
Lisa Chen
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Analytics
lisa.chen@acme-analytics.com
Attachment: Acme_PO_Template.pdf

-----Original Message-----
(quoted for context)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme-analytics.com>, Tim O'Neill <tim.oneill@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap + procurement questions — pricing/packaging alignment (need options)

Team —

Forwarding Lisa's procurement answers and PO template. They prefer PO (net-30) and marketplace is optional — pilot should be flexible but could convert to a commit by month 3.

Can you propose two succinct commercial paths we can present to procurement:
A) Pilot: Hosted on-demand (card/PO) pricing with net-30 billing and minimal commitment; include cancellation/exit terms and data retention notes.
B) Committed: 12-month Dedicated reserve with X vCPU/GPU equivalent commit tiers and discounted unit pricing; outline minimums required and marketplace vs direct billing implications.

Also flag: Acme is SOC 2 concerned and mentioned possible Private later — include note on migration path and incremental costs.

Please draft a short SOW (1-2 pages) and attach the redlined pricing worksheet. I’ve attached the PO template from the customer to help legal/billing alignment.

Thanks — need to send options back to Lisa by tomorrow EOD PT.

-Aditya

--
Attachment: Acme_PO_Template.pdf (from customer)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 13:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick recap + procurement questions — pricing/packaging alignment (need options)

Thanks for the forward — drafting two concise commercial paths now. High-level guidance / questions for the proposal:

Pilot (Hosted on-demand):
- Term: 3-month pilot recommended. Billing: Net-30 via PO (we can invoice monthly).
- Pricing: On-demand per-token rates + embedding batch rates. Recommend capping spend with an agreed monthly not-to-exceed for the pilot.
- SLA/Support: Standard hosted SLA + 1x onboarding SE hours included.
- Exit: 30-day cancellation notice; data export and deletion clause in SOW.

Committed (Dedicated reserve):
- Term: 12 months. Commit bands: Small/Medium/Large (examples: 500K tokens/mo, 2M tokens/mo, 5M+ tokens/mo) — each band maps to reserved GPU capacity.
- Pricing: ~25-35% discount vs on-demand depending on commit level. Provide burst capacity options for peak windows.
- Billing: We can accept PO for annual invoicing or monthly invoice against committed spend.
- Marketplace: If the customer wants AWS Marketplace, pricing structure needs to be adjusted (marketplace takes a %), so discounts are slightly lower; we can do direct PO to keep full discount.

Private/on-prem note:
- Migration path: We can pilot on Hosted, then move to Private with a migration SOW; Private requires additional infra fees and lead time (6-8 weeks for on-prem orchestration).

Next ask for customer: Please confirm expected peak TPS and a rough 12-month forecast so we can pick an appropriate commit band.

I’ll attach a one-page SOW and redlined pricing worksheet (commits-vs-ondemand) for Aditya to send back.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
--
Attachment stubs: redwood-pricing-commits-vs-ondemand.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_Draft.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acme-analytics.com>, Tim O'Neill <tim.oneill@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & two commercial paths (pilot vs committed) — Redwood

Hi Lisa / Tim —

Thanks for the PO template and answers — looping back with two streamlined options so procurement can choose the easiest path forward. Attached: Redwood_SOW_Draft.pdf and a short pricing worksheet (commits vs on-demand).

Option 1 — Pilot (Recommended to start quickly):
- Term: 3 months pilot; billing via PO (net-30).
- Scope: Hosted API (generation + embeddings), token-based on-demand pricing, monthly invoice.
- Controls: Monthly not-to-exceed cap (you pick threshold), onboarding SE hours included.
- Useful if you want minimal paperwork and faster start.

Option 2 — Committed (cost savings if usage predictable):
- Term: 12 months committed capacity (Dedicated reserve).
- Commit bands and savings: example bands provided in attached sheet (25-35% lower unit prices).
- Billing: We can invoice annually or monthly against committed credits — PO accepted.
- Note: If you prefer AWS Marketplace billing we need to adjust discounts slightly; direct PO preserves full discount.

Next steps (suggested):
1) You confirm Pilot vs Committed preference and provide a 3-month usage estimate (peak TPS + monthly token estimate).
2) If PO: please return the completed PO template (Acme_PO_Template.pdf) with billing contact and remit-to info.
3) If Committed: confirm desired commit band and whether you prefer marketplace or direct vendor billing.
4) We’ll send the final SOW + invoice after you confirm path.

I’ve attached the SOW draft and pricing worksheet for your review. Happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk procurement/legal through the SOW if helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to getting a pilot contracted and onboarded.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Draft.pdf, redwood-pricing-commits-vs-ondemand.xlsx
